mapper.sql: id, type, title, content_md, content_plain, parent_id, source_date, review_status, mastery, next_review_at, review_count, last_reviewed_at, pinned, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO entry (type, title, content_md, content_plain, parent_id, source_date, review_status, mastery, next_review_at, pinned) VALUES (#{type}, #{title}, #{contentMd}, #{contentPlain}, #{parentId}, #{sourceDate}, #{reviewStatus}, #{mastery}, #{nextReviewAt}, #{pinned})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM entry WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE entry SET type = #{type}, title = #{title}, content_md = #{contentMd}, content_plain = #{contentPlain}, parent_id = #{parentId}, source_date = #{sourceDate}, pinned = #{pinned}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
UPDATE entry SET deleted_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, type, title, source_date, parent_id, review_status, mastery, next_review_at FROM entry WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND type = 'note' ORDER BY source_date, id
SELECT FROM entry WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY deleted_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM entry WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND type = 'note' AND review_status = 'learning' AND next_review_at IS NOT NULL AND next_review_at <= now() ORDER BY next_review_at LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT count(*) FROM entry WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND type = 'note' AND review_status = 'learning' AND next_review_at IS NOT NULL AND next_review_at <= now()
mapper.update: UPDATE entry SET mastery = GREATEST(0, LEAST(5, mastery + #{delta})), next_review_at = now() + make_interval(days => #{days}::int), review_count = review_count + 1, last_reviewed_at = now(), review_status = CASE WHEN GREATEST(0, LEAST(5, mastery + #{delta})) >= 3 THEN 'mastered' ELSE 'learning' END, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND type = 'note' AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE ancestors AS ( SELECT CAST(#{newParentId} AS bigint) AS id UNION ALL SELECT e.parent_id FROM entry e JOIN ancestors a ON e.id = a.id WHERE e.parent_id IS NOT NULL ) SELECT count(*) FROM ancestors WHERE id = #{childId}
SELECT id, type, title, content_plain, source_date FROM entry WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (embedded_hash IS NULL OR embedded_hash <> md5(content_plain)) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT count(*) FROM entry WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (embedded_hash IS NULL OR embedded_hash <> md5(content_plain))
SELECT count(*) FROM entry WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND embedding IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE entry SET embedding = CAST(#{vector} AS vector), embedded_hash = md5(content_plain) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, type, title, content_plain, source_date, 1 - (embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector)) AS score FROM entry WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND embedding IS NOT NULL ORDER BY embedding <=> CAST(#{vector} AS vector) LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM entry WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND id IN #{id}
